==Description==
'''M-340''' is a weakened blackhole who is the mid game boss of R:FF:R who's main goal is to brutally kill the player in any way, shape, or form possible. Even if it means it will have to kill itself for that to come true.

==Trivia==
* '''M-340''' is an anarchist.
* Collese confirmed that in his first concept he was originally Female. But that was changed for reasons that Collese forgot.
* '''M-340''' was originally just going to be a normal entity and not a boss.
* '''M-340''' will have a voice actor.

== Lore ==
* '''M-340''' is the result of a failed shadow infection, that's how he gained his power.
* '''M-340''' is the main supply of power for the M section.
